suggestion.topic: Python GIL Explained: Why Multi-Threading Lies to You
suggestion.rationale: Python's Global Interpreter Lock (GIL) is a notorious bottleneck that every Python developer encounters when scaling CPU-bound tasks, making it a high-search-volume topic for advanced optimization.
suggestion.hook_angle: Your multi-threaded Python code is lying to you—here is why adding more threads actually slows your app down.
